1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line and letter spacing, though it appears to be a standard system font rather than a dedicated dyslexia-friendly one.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs appear anywhere; every visible instruction is a single short sentence-case line.

3.why: Content sits in a narrow single-column card with large labels and inputs that would scale well to mobile, though the screenshots themselves are desktop-width so true mobile rendering is inferred.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in to begin. Take your time.' and 'Enter the same contact details again.' are short and plainly worded.

5.why: Every input shows an example, both as placeholder text (e.g. 'name@example.com', '07123 456789') and as 'Demo:' values beneath each field.

6.why: No long blocks of text appear on any screen; all content is broken into short lines and single-sentence hints.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control is visible on any screen, and the flow crashes at step 2 with 'Invalid array length' before any codes or secrets are ever presented.

8.why: No QR code or any equivalent alternative to manual entry appears in any of the four screenshots.

9.why: The inputs look like standard HTML fields, but nothing in the screenshots confirms or denies autofill or password-manager support.

10.why: Each screen shows a clear 'Step X of 6' indicator with the step name, and a large high-contrast blue primary button.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one primary action ('Sign in and continue', then 'Confirm my identity').

12.why: Sign-in produces a plain confirmation with the next step ('You are signed in. Next, confirm your identity.'), but the next action produces the cryptic 'Invalid array length' with no statement of what happened or what to do next.

13.why: Hints explicitly state 'You can retry any step' and 'You can correct and retry these details', but no reveal/hide or re-request-code controls are observed.

14.why: The only error message shown is the raw technical string 'Invalid array length', which neither explains the problem in user terms nor states how to fix it.

15.why: The interface explicitly states 'No reading timer. You can retry any step.' and no countdowns, timers, or auto-updating elements appear on any screen.
